turn.user_message: Explain the first three steps on the round
turn.context: Automations place, turn 3 (the loop on the evening round, and who says yes).

transcript.label: Automations · three steps on the round

text: The summary was already filling in. Here are the three steps on the evening round, and who says yes at each.
Tojo gathers, checks and drafts. People make every decision.
prompts: How would you record each decision?
What if the doctor changes their mind?
Does it work for insured patients?
chat.pointer: Pick a step. The loop lights where Tojo is.

blocks.title: Three steps, one yes each
blocks.deck: What happens between the doctor’s word and the draft on their phone.

blocks.hint: Pick a step. The loop lights where Tojo is, and its sheet opens.
blocks.caption: Tojo’s loop: it notices, gathers, checks, drafts, then asks a person.
never: It never decides who goes home.
It never signs for a doctor.
It never guesses a missing result.
It never changes a patient’s record.

sheets.title: Hear the decision
sheets.text: The doctor taps once on the ward phone to say the patient can likely go tomorrow. Tojo takes that as its signal.

lines.label: Checks first
lines.value: It is the patient’s own doctor

lines.label: And
lines.value: The patient is not waiting on a test

sheets.entry: What would stop a patient going tomorrow?

hand.does: Taps once to say the patient can likely go.

sheets.title: Put the draft together
sheets.text: Tojo gathers the facts recorded since admission. It writes the draft summary, the expected bill and the medicines to take home.

lines.label: And
lines.value: The bill matches what was used

sheets.entry: Which part of the summary is hardest to write?

sheets.title: Ask for the yes
sheets.text: The draft is on the doctor’s phone. Anything missing or unclear is marked for the doctor to look at.

lines.label: Checks first
lines.value: Late reports are named, never guessed

sheets.entry: Who else should see the draft?

hand.does: Reads the early summary, then signs or corrects it.
